fix(config): a click's proof shares the render cache's installed layers and reads its home's disk (candybar-testing-ihvy.5zt)

- ConfigHome carries the installed-layer memo its loads share; the render
  cache lends its own through the verb context, so a click's proof checks no
  plugin the bar's last load already checked. The memo keys on definition
  text, so a lent memo serves no layer the borrower's disk does not hold.
- presence() reads ENOTDIR as absent, as the stat it replaced did: a path
  through a regular file holds nothing. The filesystem contract pins ENOTDIR.
- A click reads its home's text and the layers above on the disk its proof
  loads; config-file-store leaves FS_READERS.
- The lane edge's fileExists asks the same disk as its presence.
- stateFromLoad folds into loadFromDisk; keyLoad is module-private.

feat(config): a renderer loads config as a value over the filesystem port (candybar-testing-ihvy.5zt)

Every read a config load makes goes through the FilesystemReads it is
handed: the answers book, discovery, worktree links, plugin folders, each
layer and each definition. readConfigLoad (src/config/load.ts) is the load
as a value; the render cache builds state from it. Each definition is read
once per load, and the installed-plugin memo is an owned value keyed on
the texts, not module state keyed on a stat. The answers book's read moves
into Config, the state-file store into src/disk. Repo-approval cases move
to test/unit over the fake. Ten files leave FS_READERS; Config gets an
import rule.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
refactor(feed): arm is the one rule that a timer is never set later than it falls due (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.1s0)

fix(feed): a wake after a frame's render brings the next frame forward (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.1s0)

The feed's phase splits drawing into rendering, whose wakes the frame
reads, and pushing, whose wakes mark the frame so its schedule draws the
next a spacing on. No sink wakes synchronously today; a lane refused
mid-push did, and waited out the still period untimed.

fix(lanes): a stamp says where its session runs, outside tmux included, and a lookup reads each record once (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.aom)

Medium review of #663:
- The record is read for every request, so a session its Claude Code holds outside tmux releases the pane it was held in; an unconfirmed one releases nothing.
- One lookup reads each record once, however many of its sessions it weighs.
- A click's commit judges by the record as it reads then.
- The bar pane's waiting line says what it waits for, and where a rendered statusline says why it isn't the pane's.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(lanes): a pane's session is read from its Claude Code's record at the asking, and a request not known to run in a pane releases nothing (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.aom)

High review of #663:
- The takeover check and the pane-session reply read the record when they ask, so a stamp from before a /clear no longer answers for the pane.
- A request whose parent is not the pane's Claude Code is no evidence about where its session runs: a held session stays where it is.
- A record that fails to parse is read once more: Claude Code rewrites it in place.
- One record reader: the lane edge is handed the daemon's.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(lanes): a pane's status line and bar pane follow the session its Claude Code holds, not any client run in the pane (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.aom)

Every process in a tmux pane inherits TMUX and TMUX_PANE, so a one-shot
`cc-candybar` run from Claude Code's Bash tool, under any session id, became
"the pane's session": the status line released the pane to it and a bar pane
followed it.

The client now reports its parent pid (for a statusline, Claude Code itself,
measured on 2.1.299). The render checkpoint reads that process's own record,
`<config dir>/sessions/<pid>.json`, the one the restart already reads, and
stamps the request with the pane its session runs in: outside, runs, or
unconfirmed with why. The status line's holds and the pane-session reply read
only that stamp, so namesPane is gone. Every render event records it as
`pane=`, and while the status line or a bar pane is on, an unconfirmed session's
bar carries a ⚠ that says why.

fix(click): a click is read once at the daemon's edge, and its event carries that read (brandon-menus-sjhy.ovq) (#665)

* fix(click): a click is read once at the daemon's edge, and its event carries that read (brandon-menus-sjhy.ovq)

The edge read a click to find its session, then the verb's run read the raw
value again, and the journal, the landing stamp and the fold took their
session from that second read. Now `readClick` reads a link once, at the
edge, into a branded Click whose dispatch session is taken from its effects
in the read. The click event carries that Click, and `runClick` runs from it,
so the session the reply facts record, the one the journal and landing use,
and the steps the fold performs are one value.

The click table holds what a link can name: dispatch, and the doctor's
probe, whose nonce is now parsed at the edge too. A link naming a leaf verb
itself, which nothing draws, is an unknown click verb refused at the edge.
foldEffects is the one leaf runner. VERBS, VERB_NAMES, ClickVerb, clickVerb,
clickSessionOf and decodeWire are gone, and the drawn-link reader refuses a
link that names anything but dispatch.

Tests click as the bar does. The helpers that split a drawn link and ran
each effect as its own click (one turn and undo step per effect, no
batching) run the whole link, and hand-built single-verb clicks go through
a one-effect dispatch link (test/helpers/click.ts clickEffect, effectLink).

* fix(click): the loader refuses a link literal naming a verb no link names, and the link verbs are one list the click table keys off (brandon-menus-sjhy.ovq)

Review (high) on #665: an addressed literal naming a leaf verb loaded and then
clicked nothing; the click readers and their run arms now both answer to the
wire's LINK_VERBS at compile time; tests cover a session-less dispatch and a
lone % in a leaf's arguments; stale symbol names in design docs.

feat(band): a switched-off band lane holds no follower process (candybar-animation-wbxz.w33)

The band mod stops its follow child on the daemon's SWITCHED_OFF answer
instead of keeping it alive to re-ask every 5s, and turning band (A) off
uninstalls the mod so sessions started afterwards never load it. An
uninstall of a mod that is not installed is the state off asks for, so it
is said rather than thrown.
